cohort: 350 pregnant women at a tertiary care rural hospital in India
finding: A combination of maternal characteristics (advanced age, edema, proteinuria) and first-trimester biomarkers (MAP > 90 mmHg, UtA-PI > 1.69, PAPP-A < 0.69 ml/IU) was significantly associated with the prediction of hypertensive diseases of pregnancy.
mod_finding: There was a significant increase in cesarean sections in hypertensive patients.
